enableSearch.title: Search catalog and view product details
enableSearch.description: Lets the AI search products, check stock and view details from Ecommerce.

enableDeals.title: Active deals and savings quotes
enableDeals.description: Lets the AI look up active deals and calculate savings for visitors.

enableTop.title: Top and new products
enableTop.description: Lets the AI recommend top sellers and new arrivals.

enableMyOrders.title: My orders and account info
enableMyOrders.description: Lets verified signed-in visitors ask about their recent orders and account details.

enableTrackShipment.title: Track shipments
enableTrackShipment.description: Lets verified signed-in visitors track package shipments.

productCards.title: Show product cards
productCards.description: Shows rich interactive product cards below AI answers when products are recommended.
